features.title: Engine fork, Guimarães config, shell, green build
features.user_visible_behavior: The app runs for the Guimarães city config and draws its terrain and city fabric.
features.notes: Forked from braga-3d. cities/guimaraes.json holds the centre, core and ring bboxes, 18 candidates.

features.title: Core geodata: terrain, buildings, roads, nature
features.user_visible_behavior: The map shows real Guimarães terrain, OSM buildings, the street network and green areas.

check-fit OK: all landmarks within tolerance; never-shrink: no model smaller than real

features.title: Engine sync mechanism with braga-3d

verification: scripts/sync-engine.sh reports changes; scripts/engine-base.txt records the base
features.notes: Report-only by default; --apply copies, --record advances the base.
